title: Internal-image signed scalar tensor representative
statement: For every pair of internal complexes whose reconstructed images satisfy the stated K-flat and flat-term hypotheses, the fixed signed equation holds on their section-equivalence images.

source.place: Tag 07A4, normalized signed total-complex representative argument.

proof.text: The tensor of the two reconstructed K-flat flat-term complexes is K-flat with flat terms. Transport these properties across totalComparison, including its degreewise evaluation isomorphisms, to the reconstructed image of P tensor Q.

Apply hscalar to P, Q and P tensor Q using the transported flatness facts. Apply the proved categorical pasting theorem to these three equations. The pasting theorem contains the ordinary generator, signed totalization and derived tensor counit arguments; no new unproved obligation is introduced.

proof_origin.place: Tags 07A4 and 06YU: K-flat total models, transport of flatness, and the proved scalar tensor comparison pasting.

mathlib_searches.results: No direct existing theorem; this is the declared substep.
